property.name: coordinator_host
property.description: Derived from the assigned Trino Coordinator.

property.name: worker_hosts
property.description: Derived from assigned Trino Workers; empty means coordinator-only.

property.name: http_port
property.description: Trino HTTP port on all nodes. Keep access on a trusted network until authentication and TLS are configured outside this basic pack.

property.name: java_home
property.description: Preinstalled Java 25 runtime. Older or newer Java releases are rejected.

property.name: node_environment
property.description: Stable environment shared by all Trino nodes.

property.name: binary_url
property.description: Optional HTTPS mirror of the pinned Trino 483 archive. The SHA-512 must match.
